assumptions: The core, not the aliquot, is the independent unit (cores placed randomly within zones; aliquots share one core's sediment), so aliquots were pooled per core by summing counts (300 specimens per core).
Bray-Curtis on relative abundance of pooled counts; free permutation, 9999 permutations, seed 1.
issues: The 18 aliquots are pseudoreplicates; testing them as 18 independent samples would inflate n and the significance. Pooled to 6 cores (3 per zone).
Permutation p-value is 0.1 with only 6 cores, so power is low.
summary: Summed aliquots a-c per core, then ran a one-way PERMANOVA (Bray-Curtis, relative abundance) of zone with the Palaeo toolkit on 6 cores: pseudo-F 2.542, R2 0.3885, p 0.1. Run bundle is in runs/598e6b2157b14169bcca2e2cddf50e76. Pooled inputs are cores.tsv and cores_zones.csv.
